name: park_gap
comment: clearance between a parked carriage and the build area

name: end_allow
comment: motor / idler allowance at each end of the X beam

name: x_beam_len
comment: X beam length - IDEX needs both carriages parked clear

name: frame_d
comment: frame depth, Y - a bedslinger needs twice the build depth

name: base_h
comment: height of the base rail the uprights stand on

name: foot_bolt_pitch
comment: blind bolt pattern in the 4040 end - the four cell centres

name: foot_bolt_len
comment: M5 x 16 at the feet: 13.8 mm engagement, past 2x diameter

name: beam_y
comment: X beam Y position - sits clear of the Z block and carriage plate

name: top_tie_h
comment: thickness of the top tie bar

name: mgn_rail_h
comment: MGN12 rail height above its mounting face

name: mgn_block_h
comment: MGN12H block height above the mounting face

name: bed_rail_spacing
comment: centres of the two Y rails

name: bed_sz
comment: heated bed size - must be >= build_x and build_y

name: bed_top
expression: base_h + p20 + mgn_rail_h + mgn_block_h + bed_plate_t + bed_spacer_t + heatbed_t + magnet_t + pei_t
comment: top surface of the heated bed - Z zero

name: z_screw_x
comment: screw centre from upright outer face

name: block_pitch
comment: X spacing between the two MGN12H blocks

name: th_drop
comment: X beam underside to nozzle tip - set by the toolhead
